task.name: validate-doctype
task.description: Validate DocType definition for common issues

steps.step: Check JSON: Validate DocType JSON syntax is correct
Check fields: Verify all required fields present (name, fieldname, fieldtype)
Check naming: Verify naming_rule or autoname set
Check permissions: Verify at least one role has permissions
Check links: Verify Link field options reference valid DocTypes

validation_checklist.check: All fields have fieldname, label, fieldtype
At least one role permission exists
Link field options are valid DocTypes

error_handling.error: Fix JSON syntax errors in .json file
Update Link field options to valid DocType name
